caption: The drawing depicts an ornate decorative swag or valance, likely part of an interior decor element such as theater drapery or ceremonial fabric. The main fabric is dark green with blue and purple undertones, draped in a semi-circular shape. Across the upper portion is a light blue, semi-transparent fabric featuring white lace trim along the edge, and red vertical lines that form a subtle plaid or checked pattern. The lower edge of the swag is bordered by a thick, elaborate golden band decorated with symmetrical repeating patterns, including small red diamonds and stylized leaf motifs in a darker yellow or brown. The drapery is supported on either end by large, gold-colored medallion ornaments, and at the center top by a round gold rosette with a horizontal gold bar extending from it. Beneath the swag, swirling blue forms resembling stylized water or waves are visible. The overall composition is rectangular and is centrally positioned on a plain, off-white background.
title: Wall Paper Border Design
